doc.brief: `GtkFontChooser` is an interface that can be implemented by widgets for choosing fonts.
doc.md:
`GtkFontChooser` is an interface that can be implemented by widgets
for choosing fonts.

In GTK, the main objects that implement this interface are
[`FontChooserWidget`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FontChooserWidget), [`FontChooserDialog`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FontChooserDialog) and
[`FontButton`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FontButton).

get_font.md:
Gets the currently-selected font name.

Note that this can be a different string than what you set with
[`FontChooser.set_font()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FontChooser#method:set_font), as the font chooser widget may
normalize font names and thus return a string with a different
structure. For example, “Helvetica Italic Bold 12” could be
normalized to “Helvetica Bold Italic 12”.

Use [`FontDescription.equal()`](xref:gtk:Pango.FontDescription#method:equal) if you want to compare two
font descriptions.

get_font_desc.md:
Gets the currently-selected font.

Note that this can be a different string than what you set with
[`FontChooser.set_font()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FontChooser#method:set_font), as the font chooser widget may
normalize font names and thus return a string with a different
structure. For example, “Helvetica Italic Bold 12” could be
normalized to “Helvetica Bold Italic 12”.

Use [`FontDescription.equal()`](xref:gtk:Pango.FontDescription#method:equal) if you want to compare two
font descriptions.

get_font_face.brief: Gets the `PangoFontFace` representing the selected font group details (i.e. family, slant, weight, width, etc).
get_font_face.md:
Gets the `PangoFontFace` representing the selected font group
details (i.e. family, slant, weight, width, etc).

If the selected font is not installed, returns `NULL`.

get_font_family.brief: Gets the `PangoFontFamily` representing the selected font family.
get_font_family.md:
Gets the `PangoFontFamily` representing the selected font family.

Font families are a collection of font faces.

If the selected font is not installed, returns `NULL`.

get_font_features.md:
Gets the currently-selected font features.

The format of the returned string is compatible with the
[CSS font-feature-settings property](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-fonts-4/#font-rend-desc).
It can be passed to `new`.

get_font_map.brief: Gets the custom font map of this font chooser widget, or `NULL` if it does not have one.
get_font_map.md:
Gets the custom font map of this font chooser widget,
or `NULL` if it does not have one.

get_language.md: Gets the language that is used for font features.

get_level.md: Returns the current level of granularity for selecting fonts.

set_language.brief: Sets the language to use for font features.
set_language.md: Sets the language to use for font features.

set_level.brief: Sets the desired level of granularity for selecting fonts.
set_level.md: Sets the desired level of granularity for selecting fonts.

set_preview_text.brief: Sets the text displayed in the preview area.
set_preview_text.md:
Sets the text displayed in the preview area.

The `text` is used to show how the selected font looks.

set_show_preview_entry.brief: Shows or hides the editable preview entry.
set_show_preview_entry.md: Shows or hides the editable preview entry.

font.brief: The font description as a string, e.g. "Sans Italic 12".
font.md: The font description as a string, e.g. "Sans Italic 12".

font-features.md:
The selected font features.

The format of the string is compatible with
CSS and with Pango attributes.

language.brief: The language for which the font features were selected.

preview-text.brief: The string with which to preview the font.
preview-text.md: The string with which to preview the font.

show-preview-entry.brief: Whether to show an entry to change the preview text.
show-preview-entry.md: Whether to show an entry to change the preview text.

font-activated.brief: Emitted when a font is activated.
font-activated.md:
Emitted when a font is activated.

This usually happens when the user double clicks an item,
or an item is selected and the user presses one of the keys
Space, Shift+Space, Return or Enter.
